protocol.name: tars_menu_v1
protocol.copyright:

This protocol is part of TARS and lives in its repository (terminal/protocol/), not in terminal/vendor/ — nothing fetches it. Only TARS clients bind it.

description.summary: TARS menu model and native Cmd keys

protocol.description:
The TARS compositor (the TARS terminal) eats the Cmd chords in its own table and sends every other key to the focused client.
A client that does not bind tars_menu_manager_v1 is in compat mode: the compositor shows the Super modifier (Cmd) as Control in wl_keyboard.modifiers, so Cmd+V reaches it as Ctrl+V. A client that binds tars_menu_manager_v1 (any version) is in native mode: Cmd reaches it as Super, and Cmd+A is not Ctrl+A.
Version 2 adds the menu model. The compositor draws the menu bar at the top of the screen and the menus that drop from it. A window that has a menu model shows its menus there while it has the keyboard focus; a window without one shows only its name. When the user picks an item, the compositor sends the item's id back (tars_menu_v1.activated). The client only declares the model; shortcut keys still reach the client as keys, the compositor only shows them.

interface.name: tars_menu_manager_v1

description.summary: declares that the client takes Cmd as Super

interface.description: Binding this global puts the client in native mode for its whole life. Destroying the object does not change the mode.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the object. The client stays in native mode. Menu objects made from it keep working.

request.name: get_menu

description.summary: get the menu model object of a toplevel

request.description: Create the menu model object of a toplevel. A toplevel has at most one; asking again for the same toplevel while the first one exists is the already_constructed error. The new object has an empty model: the window shows only its name until the first commit.

interface.name: tars_menu_v1

description.summary: the menu model of one toplevel

interface.description:
The requests build a pending model: add_menu starts a menu, and add_item and add_separator append to the last menu started. commit makes the pending model the shown model, replacing the old one as a whole, and empties the pending model. reset empties the pending model without showing anything. There is no partial update.
Limits: 8 menus, 32 entries (items and separators) in one menu, 128 entries in all, 64 bytes for a title or a label, which must be UTF-8. Going over a limit is a protocol error.
If the toplevel is destroyed first, the object becomes inert: requests are accepted and ignored. Destroying the object removes the model.

entry.name: too_many
entry.summary: more menus or entries than the limits

entry.name: too_long
entry.summary: a title or a label longer than 64 bytes

entry.name: bad_utf8
entry.summary: a title or a label that is not UTF-8

entry.name: no_menu
entry.summary: an item or a separator before any add_menu

entry.name: already_constructed
entry.summary: the toplevel already has a menu object

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the object and remove the model. The window shows only its name.

request.name: add_menu

description.summary: start a menu in the pending model

request.description: Start a menu with this title. Items and separators added after it go into it.

request.name: add_item

description.summary: append an item to the last menu

request.description: Append an item. id is what activated sends back; the compositor does not check that ids are unique. shortcut_mods uses the bits of wl_keyboard.modifiers (shift 0x1, ctrl 0x4, alt 0x8, super 0x40) and shortcut_key is an evdev key code; a key of 0 means no shortcut. The compositor only shows the shortcut.

description.summary: append a separator line to the last menu

request.name: commit
request.description: Replace the shown model with the pending model, then empty the pending model. A commit of an empty pending model leaves the window with only its name.

event.name: activated
event.description: The user picked the item with this id from the shown model.
